title: oberna behen subsp. prostrata
intro: Oberna behen subsp. prostrata, commonly known as creeping Oberna, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the family Scrophulariaceae. It has been traditionally used in South African herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include the ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Oberna behen subsp. prostrata are attributed to its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and anxiolytic properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
